notes.title: Balance Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the feedback, swarm!

Over the past three days, we've been hard at work addressing your comments on balance, bugs, and overall gameplay issues. Your support and detailed reports helped us pinpoint the key areas for improvement. This update brings targeted changes to both factions, improves overall quality of life, and fixes some long-standing technical issues.

We’ve made mosquitoes stronger, humans a bit more fair, and the game as a whole more enjoyable to play — whether you’re biting or blasting.

Here’s what’s new:

Mosquito Balance Changes 
- Base stamina increased to 80
- Number of lives per mosquito increased to 4
- Dash ability is no longer removed when using teleport
- Changed the color of the Astral buff for mosquitoes
- Improved QTE behavior for mosquitoes
- Added more mosquito hiding spots on the third map



Human Balance Adjustments 
- RPG price increased to 120
- Maximum RPG count reduced to 2
- Maximum number of boxing gloves reduced to 1
- Defensive spray charge reduced by 20%
- Added a delay to the door on the second map to block human abuse
- Switch of camera to third person camera while emoting



Gameplay & Quality of Life 
- Added FOV setting
- Added game version check
- Removed overflow on flowers
- QTE no longer resets due to small intersections
- Fixed bug where escape point wasn’t visible after respawn from Astral
- Added visual indicators for: casino, music player, laptop, and human quests
- Updated the model of the electric fly swatter
- Fixed music player bug on preset 2 of the first map


Progression & Rewards 
- Defeat now grants 100 XP instead of 50 XP


Other Fixes
- Fixed issues in Portuguese localization
- Fixed crash on first launch for some players

notes.title: The Mosquito Gang Is Out Now – Join the Swarm!
notes.notes:
🎉 The Mosquito Gang is OUT NOW! 🦟

Hey everyone!

The wait is finally over — The Mosquito Gang is officially released and available to play right now on Steam! 🎮

From a quirky idea to full-on asymmetric multiplayer mayhem, it’s been a wild ride. Today, we couldn’t be more proud (and honestly, a bit emotional) to launch this project into the world.

But before we dive into what’s waiting for you in the full version, we want to say this loud and clear:

THANK YOU!

To every single one of you who joined us during the beta tests — thank you.
To everyone who reported bugs, offered insights, suggested improvements, or just showed up to play — you were instrumental in shaping this game.

Your feedback helped us balance core systems.
Your bug reports helped us squash even the sneakiest issues.
Your support gave us the motivation to bring this wild idea to life.

This launch is yours as much as it is ours. 💛

🦟 What’s in the Release?
3 chaotic, handcrafted maps

A full arsenal of weapons and gadgets for humans

Diverse mosquito abilities to create your own playstyle

Cosmetics to dress up in peak bug (or human) fashion

Full support for Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck

Whether you're out for blood or fighting to swat it away — there's never been a better time to join the chaos.

📅 What’s Next? Here's Our June Roadmap!
We're just getting started — and we’ve got big plans ahead. Here's a sneak peek at what's coming next:

🛠️ May 31 – First Hotfix
⚖️ June 6 – Balance Patch (based on your early feedback)
🚀 June 26 – Major Content Update

Check out the full visual roadmap below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44896781/431502f1ef2b1338a74159a66615d91bd7253f48.png[/img]

We’re excited to keep improving the game with you — one patch (and bite) at a time.

💬 Stay Connected
Check out the FAQ Thread on Steam Discussions for answers, and patch notes.
And don’t forget to join our Discord to stay up to date, chat with other players, and give feedback directly to the dev team.

Thanks again for being part of the journey.
See you in the swarm,
– The Space Raccoon Team 🧡

notes.title: New Trailer, New Info – The Mosquito Gang Launches May 20!
notes.notes:
Hey, The Mosquito Gang community! 🦟

We hope you’ve had a chance to check out our brand-new trailer! We aimed to make it fun, quirky, and action-packed—while also giving you a clear picture of what’s coming.

With the release date officially set for May 20, we want to make sure everyone knows what to expect on launch day!

Our whole team hopes you enjoyed the trailer and are just as excited for release as we are. So, here’s a quick look at what’s waiting for you on day one:

🛠️ What to Expect at Release:
🗺️ 3 Unique Maps
Dive into chaotic battles across a variety of handcrafted locations.

🦟 Build-A-Bug System
Use a wide variety of abilities to create your own unique mosquito build mid-match.

🔫 Weapons & Gadgets for Humans
Fend off the swarm with everything from bug spray to brutal tech.

💅 Stylish Cosmetics
Customize your mosquito or human with peak fashion-forward flair.

🖥️ Full Platform Support
Play on Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck—right out of the box.

We’ve also put together a fresh FAQ thread over in the Steam Discussions—make sure to give it a read if you have questions!

And don’t forget to join our Discord to stay updated on everything happening around The Mosquito Gang.

Thanks for being here with us—we can’t wait to see you in the swarm on May 20! 💥

notes.title: Kickstarting 2025: Chinese New Year Beta Awaits!
notes.notes:
Greetings, The Mosquito Gang community! 🐝

We’re thrilled to kick off 2025 with the very first developer news of the year! To celebrate the Chinese New Year, we’re preparing a special Closed Beta Test with exciting new content and updates.

The Closed Beta Test will take place during the first weekend of February, starting at 13:00 GMT+3 on February 1st and ending at 24:00 GMT+3 on February 2nd.

All participants will receive exclusive cosmetics for both Mosquitoes and Humans, making this an event you don’t want to miss! 🧧🎨

Players who joined the Closed Beta Test via registration or key-activation previously will be able to participate!

Stay tuned for the full changelog and more exciting details as we draw closer to the event.

See you in the beta and Happy New Year! 🎉

notes.title: Next Phase of Closed Beta Test Begins with Halloween Event!
notes.notes:
Hello Mosquito Gang Community!

We’re thrilled to announce the next phase of the closed beta test for The Mosquito Gang! Mark your calendars because the new test period begins today at 20:00 (GMT+3) on November 2, 2024 and will continue until 20:00 (GMT+3) on November 4, 2024.

During this test phase, we’ve implemented some crucial bug fixes to improve gameplay performance and overall user experience. We’ve listened closely to your feedback from previous tests, and our development team has been hard at work squashing those pesky bugs that were buzzing around!

In addition to these updates, we’re excited to introduce a special Halloween event exclusive to this testing phase. This limited-time Halloween event will give players a taste of our seasonal content plans and introduce some festive frights to the game map.

Join us for this exclusive testing window, and don’t forget to share your experiences with us on the Steam community page and our Discord - server. Your feedback continues to shape The Mosquito Gang into the game we all want to see.
Thank you for being part of our community and helping us bring this world to life! See you in the game, and may you survive the haunting challenges that await.

Happy Halloween and Happy Testing!

notes.title: Important Update for Closed Beta Test
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have some key updates to share with you.

Firstly, we're beyond grateful to see so many of you diving into our Closed Beta Test – your support and dedication mean the world to us. We’re lucky to have such a passionate community, and we thank each of you for joining us on this journey!

That said, we’ve encountered some issues that require us to adjust the Beta Test schedule. To address these, access to the game will be temporarily paused starting today at 20:00 GMT+3. Please rest assured that we’re working hard to resolve everything and get back on track as soon as possible!

Planned Reopening
We’re aiming to resume access this Saturday. Although it’ll be just after Halloween, we’ll still be offering our Halloween-themed character cosmetics so you can enjoy them during the playtest.

Once again, from everyone at Space Raccoon, THANK YOU for being a part of this exciting journey. We can’t wait to jump back into the game with you all very soon!

notes.title: The Closed Beta Test starts today!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow testers!

We’re excited to announce that the closed beta test for The Mosquito Gang is officially starting today! For the next two weeks, we’ll be welcoming a limited number of registered testers into the game in small waves. This gradual rollout will help us ensure the stability and performance of the game as we fine-tune everything.

Here’s what to expect:

Tester Invites: Invites will be sent out gradually, so keep an eye on your inbox! If you haven’t received one yet, don’t worry—there’s still a chance you’ll get access.
Feedback is Key: We rely on your feedback to improve the gameplay experience. Once in the beta, you’ll have the chance to report any bugs, suggest improvements, and help shape the game’s future in our Discord community!
Stay tuned to The Mosquito Gang’s Steam page and our community channels for updates. We can’t wait to see you in the game and hear your thoughts!

P.S. If you gain access to the game and your friend doesn't, they can try joining our Discord community for a chance to obtain a key.

Happy gaming,
The Space Raccoon Game Studio Team

notes.title: Words of gratitude and news
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We decided to start this devlog by thanking all the players who added the game to their wishlist! [b]There are already more than 8 thousand of you[/b]! This is a huge motivation to work on the game, [b]thank you all[/b]!

Our team is still actively working on the game and preparing for the launch of playtests, we are working on the game cycle, working on new items and tools, working on adding visual interfaces and much more. All to deepen and expand the gameplay of the game, giving it more meaning for both factions while maintaining the balance of power.

Here's just a partial list of changes we've implemented over the past month:

[h2]Human[/h2]

We have updated the story of the game and now the person is a house worker who comes to fulfill his duties, but is taken by surprise by a mosquito gang. The person can earn money for completing small side quests and buy items, tools and weapons from an online store using a laptop.

[h2]Mosquito[/h2]

Finalize the mosquito bite system - special screen effect, targeting and, of course, a reference to stratagems

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44896781/0860a54633ecef763ab1fa9b0c3aef559927ccad.gif[/img]

The ability is a shield that will keep you from getting killed at the most dangerous moment.

[h2]Other[/h2]

We have completely updated the game description on Steam, added fresh screenshots and gifs.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
We are still actively developing the game and getting ready to launch playtests, stay tuned!

With love,
Development team
